LiveDemoChoice: Add up to four public website URLs as knowledge sources for Zava Supplier Signal Scout
WhatAdminProvides: No tenant connector required; optional web search toggle and allowed public URLs
WhatUserCanDo: Create a declarative agent that grounds answers in public supplier pages, Zava public demo repository pages, or approved public documentation
WhatItProves: Fastest no-admin extension path for business users
LearnVerifiedLimit: Public URLs must be at most two levels deep and no query parameters; up to four URLs

LiveDemoChoice: Use an admin-enabled Microsoft 365 Copilot connector such as a GitHub connector that indexes public Zava issue/order signals
WhatAdminProvides: AI admin configures or deploys the connector, grants consent, and makes connector content available in Microsoft Graph
WhatUserCanDo: Add the enabled Copilot connector as an Agent Builder knowledge source
WhatItProves: Admin can make external line-of-business data reusable for citizen-built agents
LearnVerifiedLimit: Agent Builder consumes connector content as knowledge; it does not turn the Agent Builder agent into an action-taking workflow

LiveDemoChoice: Use Microsoft Graph GitHub connector sample to index public GitHub issues or repositories as searchable Copilot knowledge
WhatAdminProvides: Developer deploys the sample connector; admin grants Graph permissions and reviews tenant-wide connector impact
WhatUserCanDo: Agent Builder can select the enabled connector once available in the tenant
WhatItProves: A public connector pattern exists without inventing a fake proprietary backend
LearnVerifiedLimit: Requires connector deployment, indexing, permissions and admin consent before it appears to users

LiveDemoChoice: Add a Model Context Protocol tool server to the Zava Fulfillment Escalation Agent
WhatAdminProvides: Developer or admin provides a streamable MCP endpoint and authentication; admin can register via Agent 365 BYO MCP preview
WhatUserCanDo: Use the MCP server as a tool in Copilot Studio to retrieve dynamic order status or supplier risk
WhatItProves: This is the right place for live tools/actions, not basic Agent Builder
LearnVerifiedLimit: BYO MCP preview does not yet support Microsoft 365 Declarative Agents; Copilot Studio is supported

LiveDemoChoice: Review MCP tool requests under Agents > Tools and approve, reject, block or unblock
WhatAdminProvides: AI admin or Global admin reviews declared tools and grants tenant-wide consent where required
WhatUserCanDo: Explain why tools need admin governance before broad use
WhatItProves: Customers see the safety layer for external tools before agents can invoke them
LearnVerifiedLimit: BYO MCP is preview; supported client surfaces include Copilot Studio, VS Code, Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI
